$comment: The shape check's config (scripts/shape.mjs), as the starter kit writes it (setup/template/shape.json.tmpl). Each rule's mend is what a failure of it says (scripts/schemas.mjs). What a schema cannot say stays with the script: a path that lies outside the project, a system that uses one the config does not hold, an entrance outside its system's paths, and what holds between the systems.
title: the shape check's config
mend: write it as the starter kit does ({core}setup/template/shape.json.tmpl): a JSON object with "baseline", the baseline's path, and "code", git pathspecs of the code to read

mendFor.additionalProperties: take it out; the config holds "baseline", "code", "tests", "systems", "aliases", "platform", "marks", "suites", "screens", "clocks", "processes", "changes", "select", "wait" and "long" alone
mendFor.required: name the baseline's path in "baseline", as the starter kit writes it (checks/shape-baseline.json), and list the code's folders in "code", as git pathspecs (":!" leaves a path out)

baseline.mend: name the baseline's path in "baseline", as the starter kit writes it (checks/shape-baseline.json)

code.mend: list the code's folders in "code", as git pathspecs (":!" leaves a path out)

tests.mend: list git pathspecs there (":!" leaves a path out)

platform.mend: list there each package or module of Node's that binds code to one platform, by the name it is imported under

screens.mend: list there each package or module a test imports that opens a screen, a window or a device, by the name it is imported under

clocks.mend: list there each name a test calls or imports that reaches a real clock (sleeps, waits on a timer or reads the time), beside those the check knows for each language: a call by its dotted name (Clock.Wait), a module by the name it is imported under

processes.mend: list there each name a test calls or imports that starts another process, beside those the check knows for each language: a call by its dotted name (Process.Start), a module by the name it is imported under

changes.mend: list there each mark of a change in a comment the project adds, as plain text the check finds anywhere in a comment line ("Ticket: ABC-", "fixed in JIRA-"), at most 20 of them, each of at most 120 characters with no control character, or take it out

select.mend: give it "proof", "whole", "none" alone, each a list of git pathspecs

wait.mend: give it a number of seconds above 0, or take it out

long.mend: give it a number of seconds above 0, or take it out

marks.mend: give "lines", "depth" and "branches" a whole number each, or leave one out for the core's own

aliases.mend: give each prefix an import may start with ("@/") the path inside the project it stands for ("src/")

suites.mend: give each suite's name its time mark in seconds: a number, or one for each of Node's names for a platform ({ "linux": 60, "win32": 240 })

systems.mend: give each system's name its "paths", and what else it declares: "uses", "entrance", "domain", "wraps"

mendFor.pattern: name it in small letters, digits and hyphens, a letter first

mendFor.required: list its folders (each ending in /) or files in "paths"

paths.mend: list its folders (each ending in /) or files there

uses.mend: list there the systems it may import from

wraps.mend: list there the packages it alone imports

entrance.mend: name the one file of the system that the others import from

domain.mend: name one of the domains {core}tasks/code-shape.md lists, or the project's own in the same form: small letters, digits and hyphens, a letter first
